features.feature_value: Multiple first-person goals using repeated 'I want' policy demands
features.evidence_span: "I want to be able to walk at night without fear" ... "I want welfare benefits" ... "I want foreigners" ... "I want voters"
features.rationale: The post uses a parallel series of 'I want' statements to enumerate policy prescriptions.

features.feature_value: Direct accusatory claim about leaders' stance toward dictators
features.evidence_span: "Trump has never said a bad thing about Putin and many other dictators because he idolizes them."
features.rationale: It asserts a specific causal relationship between admiration and lack of criticism.

features.feature_value: Use of censored profanity / taboo language
features.evidence_span: "a lot of stupid sh*t" ... "economy is in the shitter"
features.rationale: The text contains strong taboo language used to intensify critique of policy/economy.

features.feature_value: Pro/anti ICE and Border Patrol framing tied to sovereignty/community safety
features.evidence_span: "praised ICE and the Border Patrol for the role they play in defending U.S. sovereignty"
features.rationale: It centers immigration enforcement and public safety as the primary subject matter.

features.feature_value: Explicit ideology-pillar discussion with 'pivots' and contrast in second paragraph
features.evidence_span: "pillars of conservatism" ... "I agree this is one of conservatisms worst accurate criticisms" ... "pillars of progressivism"
features.rationale: The post discusses multiple ideological principles (conservatism/progressivism) and their 'worst accurate criticisms.'

features.feature_value: Claims anti-abortion hypocrisy; follow-on neglect of support; mockery
features.evidence_span: "They want to force women to have children" ... "once the kid is born they'll do nothing" ... "They make idiots look smart."
features.rationale: It combines a normative critique (hypocrisy/neglect) with a dismissive evaluative line.

features.feature_value: Minimal positive reaction plus explicit intention to mobilize political action
features.evidence_span: "Good." ... "start dragging these radical leftists in front of Congress"
features.rationale: The structure pairs a brief approval with a concrete call to pursue accountability through Congress.

features.feature_value: Second Amendment mention plus gun ownership vocabulary
features.rationale: It invokes the Second Amendment and frames gun ownership via historical/weapon-specific terms.
